protocol.cohort_admission: a cohort is admitted only if its own held-out data passes every gate (rmse, spearman, lb95, pair_rank_acc, n_heldout, |bias|, cohort rmse); the artifact 'gates' block reports the primary English cohort

pair_rule.definition: all held-out clip pairs with |MOS_i - MOS_j| >= 1.0 and non-overlapping per-clip 95% CIs (1.96*std/sqrt(votes)); accuracy = share ordered like human MOS by calibrated prediction, ties wrong
pair_rule.name: material_difference_pair_concordance_v1
pair_rule.note: substitute: the PRD's listener-confirmed same-source paired degradations are not available in this corpus

protocol.selection_criterion: lowest selection-split MOS RMSE over in-support clips; ties -> fewer knots
protocol.support: calibration-split x range (first/last knot); outside -> out_of_domain, excluded from accuracy and reported as coverage loss
